extraction.NOTES: Document is a letter dated October 20, 1928, from Superintendent E. W. Jermark requesting Mrs. Stirk call at the office to have her statement taken in affidavit form regarding her forced patent. Reference made to 'Patent in Fee' covering her allotment. File reference: 5-1142.
